_comment: The mini-code experiment matrix: one suite, one model, every setting.
This is the config to extend as mini-code grows features -- add a preset in
benchmarks/agents/mini_code.py, add its name here, and the report gains a row.
limit is 1 so the file is a smoke test by default; drop it (or pass --limit)
Terminal-Bench 2.x runs through harbor; set options.harness to "tb" to use the 1.x 'terminal-bench-core' datasets instead.
